༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo bzhugs/

na maḥshri he ru ka maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa dag gis/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'di nyid sgrub par bya'o/ /de las ni las dang dngos grub la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khyad par shin tu mang po dag 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ skye bo mang po dag la'ang mchog tu phan pa yin no/ /de la dus ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel na/ thun so so'i 'jug gi cha'am/ lhag par mchog tu bsngags pa nam phyed kyi thun mtshams la yin zhing*/ khyad par gyi dus ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ tshes brgyad dang ni khyad par du/ /bco lnga dang ni tshes bcu bzhir/ /grub 'dod rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni/ /'bad pa'i gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ de dag la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dbye bas drug dang*/ spyir gtor chog 'di tshes bcu mchod pa'i yan lag yin pa'i/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis te/ zla ba gcig gi nang du nyi ma brgyad po de dag sngags la/ lo dus kyi dbang ltar na dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu la lhag par bsngags so/ /de yang rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas nang mchod blangs te sa gzhi la byugs pa'i steng du/ thig btab nas chos 'byung bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa sgom don bzhin/ rdul tshon gyi 'bri ba'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs yod na'ang legs la/ yang na chos 'byung gi dbus su zlum bskor gsum/ lte ba le tshe dgu dang bcas pa 'bri ba'am/ de yang ma grub na chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa tsam mo/ /yang na thig btab nas tshom bu bkod kyang rung la/ yang ras bris med cing rdul tshon gyis bri ba mi lcogs na/ maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyis chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ngo*/

/de nas gtor ma gcig gam gnyis sam/ 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i lnga'am/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa sogs sha khrag gnyis sha chang dang sgog tsong la sogs pa'i brgyan pa zas bzang rgus sbags pa bzhag /chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs spyi dang mthun par bshams/ nang mchod byin rlabs dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig sgom nas/ gtor ma chang chu nang mchod kyis bran/ so so'i sgrub thabs nas ji skad 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la/ baṃ las chu khams kyi dkyil 'khor dkar po de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung khams kyi dkyil 'khor nag po/ de'i nang du raṃ las me khams kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po de'i nang du laṃ las sa khams kyi dkyil 'khor ser po'o/ /de rnams gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bral ba/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mu 'khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma dang mi ro'i gdan la/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi'i <mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ltar na/> dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ <yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar na/> phyag dang po gnyis g.yas ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas 'dzin zhing gsor pa'i rdo rje dang*/ g.yon bshor gyi rnam pa'i thod khrag 'og ma gnyis kyi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ drag po chen po/ sum bcu rtsa gsum pa thams cad kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i rgyan dang cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du phruṃ las mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang ma dkar mo thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/

byang du phraiṃ las 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu phroṃ las 'jib byed ma dmar mo/ snyim pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lhor phriṃ las g.yo ldan ma'am ngag 'phrog ma sngon mo/ phyag gnyis gtun shing dang sdigs mdzub can/ bzhi kar yang skra dmar po grol zhing*/ mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi'o/ /sa khams 'khor lo'i sgo bzhir hriḥphraiṃ hi hoḥ mtshams bzhir oṃ gaṃ biṃ iṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can/ /rab khros mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin/ /lho sgor zhi ba ma ni dmar mo ste/ /thod pa lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u 'dzin/ /nub sgor gzhon nu ma ni ser mo ste/ tri shū la ba dan gsum pa gzhu dang mda'/ /byang sgor tsa muṇ+ḍi ni sku mdog nag kha ṭ+waṃ thod pa rnge chung chang snod 'dzin/ /byang shar zur du tshangs pa kha dog dkar/ /'khor lo'i dang ni thod pa mda' gzhu bsnams/ /shar lhor tshogs kyi dbang mo ljang khu ste/ /rtse gsum thod pa bgrang phreng la du 'dzin/ /lho nub khyab 'jug ma ni nam mkha'i mdog / 'khor lo thod pa zhags pa ral gri 'dzin/ /nub byang mtshams su dbang mo mdangs 'od ser/ /shaka ti thod pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa 'dzin/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i byang shar nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad la/ īṃ iṃ aṃ aṃ neṃ pāṃ baṃ kuṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'byung por dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog chibs/ /phyag na mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa bsnams/ /shar du sa srung bu la dbang po ser/

/rdo rje dang ni thod pa phyag gis 'dzin/ /shar lhor me lha lug la zhon/ /dmar po phyag na me thab 'dzin/ /lho phyogs gshin rje nag po ste/ /ma he'i gdan steng dbyug tho 'dzin/ /lho nub srin po sngo skya ste/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing khyi la chibs/ /chu srin la gnas chu lha dkar/ /zhags pa thogs pa nub phyogs su'o/ /rlung lha dung mdog ba dan 'dzin/ /nub byang ri dwags steng na gnas/ /gter bum steng na lus ngan ser/ /rin po che 'dzin byang du gnas/ /de thams cad phyag bzhi'i g.yon gyi dang po thod pa bcud kyis gang ba dang*/ 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyor bas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i shar nas g.yas bskor gyi/ suṃ tsaṃ maṃ buṃ bṛṃ sh-iṃ shaṃ raṃ keṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nyi ma dmar ser rta mchog dkar po chibs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshan pad+ma phyag na bsnams/ /zla ba dkar po zla dkyil phyed pa'i mtshan pa yi/ /ku mud 'dzin pa ngang pa la gnas shar lhor bzhugs/ /lha sgor mig dmar dmar por skyes la gnas shing*/ /g.yas pa gri thung g.yon pas mi mgo bzungs te za/ /pad gdan la gnas gza' lhag ser po bden bral na/ /mda' gzhu 'gengs shing zhi ba'i lta bas gnas pa'o/ /nub sgor phur bu ser skya rlung du pa sangs dkar/ /gnyis ka'ang pad+ma la gnas bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spen pa sngo nag rus sbal la chibs rab tu khros/ /dbyug pa phyar zhing khu tshur dkur bsten byang sgor bzhugs/ /dbang ldan zur du sgra can dmar nag srin po'i lus/ /sprin gyi gseb nas lus stong phyung ste nyi zla 'dzin/ /de dang lhan cig mjug rings sngon po sbrul mjug can/ /klu gzugs rab tu khros pa ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ /de dag kun kyang rang gi khang pa'i steng na bzhugs/ /rgyu skar la sogs gdon gyi tshogs kyis rab tu bskor/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs ldan rang gi dam tshig spyod/

/dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir g.yon bskor gyis/ /braṃ biṃ tuṃ kaṃ mtshams bzhir maṃ raṃ baṃ yaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang po tshangs pa dkar po ni/ /zhal bzhi thod pa zlas 'phreng dang*/ /spyi blugs pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ / nor sbyin phyogs su khyab 'jug nag /phyag bzhi ral gri 'khor lo dang*/ /thod pa ga de'i dbyug pa 'dzin/ /gshin rjer drag po du ba'i mdog /mdung rtse gsum pa thod khrag dang*/ /zhags pa bzlas 'phreng phyag na bsnams/ /chu bdag phyogs su gzhon nu ser/ /gdong ba drug ldan mdung thung dang*//dbyug to thod pa bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /dbang ldan sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad ma la gnas nor 'dzin ma/ /ser mo gos dkar bum pa dang*/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/ / byin zer me yi dkyil 'khor la/ /me lce 'bar ba'i steng du ni/ /me yis lha mo me lha mtshungs/ /srin por chu'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /char sprin la gnas chu lha mo/ /mdog dbyibs phyag mtshan chu lha bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i phyogs su rlung dkyil la/ /'tshubs ma rlung ras g.yo bas mtshan/ /der gnas rlung gi lha mo ni/ / phyogs skyong rlung lha nyid dang mtshungs/ /de'i phyi rol gzhal yas khang gi sgo g.yas g.yon la/ yi ge phuḥyig brgyad las klu chen po brgyad/ sgo'i phyi rol gyi khyams la lha ma yin dang*/ lus srul po la sogs pa'i tshogs dang*/ phyi rol dur khrod kyi gnas la/ zhing skyong chen po rnams srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad byon par gyur/

phraiṃ/ oṃ sum+bha/ sogs kyis bsangs/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥ sogs/ slar yang*/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ waṃ se badz+ri ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ge badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mu ra dze badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha s+ye badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ la s+ye badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ girti badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ n-i ti badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ puṣ+pe badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhu pe badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ de pe badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gan+dhe badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pa badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra se badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i rig ma bcu drug dang*/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe ā hūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de la'ang mkha' 'gro lnga'i ming sbyor/

spros pa la dga' na lha so so'i bstod pa sbyar na yang legs/ bsdu na mi dgos/ rang gi lag pa g.yon par ā li las zla ba/ g.yas par kā li las nyi ma/ snyim pa kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharma hūṃ/ oṃ pa ra spa ra a nu pra priṣ+ta sarba dharma hūṃ/ oṃ a t+yā nā a nu pra priṣ+ta sarba dharma hūṃ/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ pad bskor bya zhing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gi /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍa ki n+ya ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ zhes pa lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul/ bar 'dir spro na/ oṃ ḍā ki ni phruṃḥphu swāhā/ oṃ dī pi ni phreṃ phuḥswāhā/ oṃ tsi ṣi ṇi phreṃ phuḥswāhā/ oṃ kaṃ po dza phraiṃ phuḥswāhā/ sngags de bzhi po'i mthar/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sogs sbyor/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ la/ a kā ro ba tags pa'am/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo ge shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ btags pa'i phag mo la phul/ des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ / oṃ āḥphraiṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhiḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥho hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpeṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ ma mo gzhan bdun gyi sngags so/ / oṃ āṃḥ.iṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥyaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥn+ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ auṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥkuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

phyogs skyong rnams kyi'o/ / oṃ āḥsuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbriṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥshuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥraṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥkaiṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gza' dgu po rnams kyi'o/ / oṃ āḥbraṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbiṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtuṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥkaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥraṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥyaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa rnams la sngar bzhin sbyar ro/ /re re bzhin tshar gsum mam bsdu na lan gcig gis phul la/ thams cad la thun mong du/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ bi shā tsa/ un+mā ta/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i mi ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+taṃ/ buñja tha/ bi ba tha/ dzi gha tha/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba kad+tha yaṃ/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha/ ma ma sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ g.yas thod pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon ba dan gsum gdengs pa'i phyag rgyas btab cing*/ oṃ he ho hriḥswāhā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas nang mchod byin rlabs kha gsos/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan mang pos g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs thor 'bul/ bla ma dang dkyil gyi lha tshogs mgron thams cad mnyes par bsam/ dpal he ru ka'i rkang brgyad gnyis dang*/ de nyid lnga pa la sogs pas bstod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs= ma mo'i= ma lus par ni thams cad dag/'di gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal bar bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung*/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cing*/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel dang chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/

las so so dang 'brel na de dang de'i las la bskul ba drag tu bya/ de nas rdo rje glu 'di blang bar bya ste/ 'gro ba kun gyi mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas ky-is/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ sham du/ /sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos/ a re/ gang gi don dam la ni ma sgoms pas/ de yi sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin te/ a re/ nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ zhes bya ba dang*/ hūṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yin/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ a la la la la ho/ a i ā a rall̥ ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i a a rall̥ ho/ rab rgyas mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i a a rall̥ ho/ bde ba spang bas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyed ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang bas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ / gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/

/oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi= sogs bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /lha mo tshad ma/ sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang*/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje chu rgyas sems la ni/ / mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang*/ /myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ bzod gsol spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can= sogs kyi mthar/ 'theb mdzub gnyis bkug ste zlum por byas la/ sor mo gzhan rkyang pa mig gis phyag rgya bstan rjes/ pad skor dang lte bar 'khyud rgya byas la/ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la muḥ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag gis dpral par thim pa dang*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha/ sogs/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lam gyi bzhi mdo sogs su bskyal/ thams cad kyis sum bha drag tu bzlas/ nang du 'ongs nas gtor skyel ba la bsangs chu'am nang mchod kyis gtor/ yon bdag la sogs pa gzhan gyi don du gtor ma btang ba yin na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang*/ dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyod kyi drangs/ khyed la rtag tu bsrung dang mchog gi 'byor pa dang*/ /yang na yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro bar 'gyur bar shog / ces brjod/ rang gzhan gyi don gang yin kyang thun mong du/

smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing*/ dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni/ /sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub par shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur te/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs gnas bcu gnyis/ /dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol pa yi/ /bu bzhin dgongs pas bdag sgrib dag gyur cig /bde ba mchog gis sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing*/ /rdo rje'i dbang mo'i zhabs dran gyur nas kyang*/ /btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing*/ /gsang ba'i pad+mor rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i/ /zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te/ /'gro ba bde ba dam pas 'phong rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang*/ /bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa/ /'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yi/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yi yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*/ /yun ring 'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*/ /gtso bor sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba/ /srid gsum rdo rje rol bar lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong*/ /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'dir ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog

/ ces sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rnams nges par gal che'o/ /de ltar na gtor ma'i chog 'di la/ dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhir byed pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa yinazhing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsung ba ltar na/ dkyil 'khor rim pa gsum yin pa'i 'byung ba bzhi dang mi sbyor la/ rgyud de nyid nas mdor bstan gyi skabs su/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha rnams la gza' brgyad dang*/ sgo 'khyud bzhir lha chen bzhi/ zur bzhir 'byung bzhi'i lha mo rnams zhal phyag can du mi mdzad par/ pad+ma dang char sprin la sogs pa'i gzugs su mdzad/ rgyas bshad kyi skabs dkyil 'khor nang ma'i lha rnams la ma mo brgyad/ de'i sgo 'khyud bzhir tshangs pa sogs lha chen bzhir 'god par dngos su bshad cing*/ des zur bzhir 'byung bzhi'i lha mo yang 'god par don gyis thob/ de gnyis 'dam kha yin pas gang ltar byas kyang 'dra/ gzhal yas khang kun la lha rnams rim pa gcig kho na yin pas/ phyi nang gang la 'god kyang lha brgyad pa rim pa gnyis 'god dgos pa de la/ lha snam zlum por bskor/ sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsig pa la ma reg tsam bya/ de la lha brgyad dang*/ sgo bzhi la lha bzhi/ gru chad bzhi la 'byung bzhi'i lha mo bkod pas legs par 'ong*/ de yang dkyil 'khor nang ma la bkod na lag len bde zhing*/ yang dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi don la/ zlum bskor le tshe dgu pa phyogs mdog can byas kyang legs par 'ong ngo*/ /de ltar 'dir dkyus su bshad pa ni/ phyi gtor gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ nang gtor gyi dbang du byas na/ pad+ma'i lte bar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus sam/ le tshe dgu'i re mig dbus ma/ shin tu yangs par gyur pa'i gnas su/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gi grub par mos/ skad cig rnam pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing*/ zhal phyag rnams rim gyis gsal btab/

de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa man chad byed cing*/ 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi skabs/ mngon rtogs dkyus dang 'dra kha cig lha sum cu so bdun po 'di bskyed pa la/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo'i dkyil 'khor la 'byung po thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bring po yin zhes 'chad pa ni/ lha grangs gcig shos mang zhing*/ bskyed chog rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par yang med pas/ rgyas 'bring gi dbye ba de 'dra ni mi 'thad la/ cig shos zhing skyong nyid gtso bo dang*/ 'di 'byung po spyi'i dkyil 'khor yin pas/ yul dang dgos pa gnyis kar cung zad mi 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhi nas tha dad yin pas/ phyir yang rgyas bsdus su 'jog rgyu ma yin no/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor gnyis po so so dus gcig tu bzhengs nas/ cho ga'i khyad par mi 'dra ba rnams so sor skabs de nyid du lhag por sbyar/ cho ga byings 'di tshar gcig gis 'gro bar byas na ni shin tu rung la/ yang kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa rgya gar mkhas pa zhig ni/ dbus su gtso bo mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i mtha' zlum bskor gsum la zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ lhag ma dkyil 'khor bzhi la gong du bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ phyi'i dur khrod la nag po drag po sogs zhing skyong brgyad/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa sgom zhes bka' stsol bar mdzad do/ /'on kyang re zhig dkyil 'khor gnyis su byed pa nyid mi legs shing*/ bla ma dam pa de'i lugs la/ gtor ma'i bshoms kyi khyad par/ bum pa chang gis bkang pa'i steng du/ kha zas dang dmar gyis gang ba'i gtor snod bzhag pa phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re dang*/ 'das gtor de ka 'dra ba gcig /brgyad po'i phyi rol lho phyogs stegs bu mtho ba la 'jog cing*/ thams cad ba dan gyis brgyan pa/ so sor dgos mchod re re dang bcas pa phyag len du mdzad kyin 'dug pa ni/

'dir yang lag len du btab na legs so/ /yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtor chog dza na se nas mdzad pa sogs las/ ye shes pa spyan drangs ma thag tu/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'od gsal du bcug nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam pa can du bzhengs gsungs par 'dug lar yang 'phags yul dang bal po phyi rabs pa rnams gtor chog phal cher la lha rnams bsgyur ba 'di ka dar bar 'dug pa'i rtsa ba'i khungs slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi gtor ma chen po'i cho ga de yin 'dug cing*/ de'i lugs la'ang nang gtor la yin gyi phyi rol pa dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs la mi bzhed la/ nang gtor la thun mong ma yin pa nang chog gis bskyed pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i/ nang tshan zhi ba'i phyogs la/ 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa dang*/ drag po'i phyogs la phur pas btab nas gser 'gyur rtsi ltar bsgyur bar byed/ 'di dag la ye shes lha'i rnam par bsgyur ba yin kyang*/ phyag mtshan dang phyibs pa sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad 'byung ngo*/ /'on kyang 'di slob dpon de las brgyud pa min pas/ gong du bshad pa nyid kyis cho ga la/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'gro ba thams cad lhag pa'i lhar shes pa rtag tu dgos la/ khyad par du yang gtor mgron thams cad he ru ka'i ngo bor mos pa brtan po ni nges par dgos pa gzhir bzhag tu snang*/ lha'i rnam pa bsgyur ba ni med mi rung kho na yang min pas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lugs gsal bar mdzad pa'i chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos las ma bshad cing*/ man ngag gi rgyun la med phyin mi dgos so/ /de bzhin du dza ya se nas 'das gtor phul ma thag de dang*/ yig brgya bzla ba'i bar du cho ga lhag ma mang du bcug pa yang 'gal ba med mod kyi lhag po yin no/ /gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su/ sgo phrag bzhi po dngos su 'bri ba yang ma grub/ thig yongs rdzogs yang gdab par ma nus na/

sgo phrag gsum mam bzhi'i rtsa thig dang phyi'i chos 'byung dang nang gi zlum thig dang bcas ba tsam btab kyang legs par 'gyur zhing*/ rdul mtshon gyis 'bri ba'i phyogs la ni/ gdan dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan 'bri nus na mchog yin la/ phyag mtshan 'bri ba ma nus na gdan 'bri zhing*/ de yang ma nus na rdul tshon gyis tshom bu'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa bha wa bha dras mdzad pa na/ nyi ma spen pa sgra gcan mjug rings rnams la nyi gdan dang*/ gza' gzhan rnams la zla gdan zhes bshad kyang*/ 'dir ni de lta bu mi dgos so/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud da lta yod pa 'di'i 'gyur dang dpe la/ 'bar byed ma dang*/ ngag 'phrog ma lho byang go spos par yod kyang*/ dpe'am 'gyur gyi skyon yin te/ mkha' 'gro bzhi po de'i bzhugs gnas kyi phyogs ni rnam pa kun tu gong bzhin yin la rgyud de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos la/ da ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang gtan nas med cing*/ 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang gdan bzhi dpang por bzhag pa'o// //de ltar na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma chen po 'di gnyis/ bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yang yin na'ang*/ deng sang phal cher gyi ming yang ma thos 'dug pas kun la phan pa'i phyir/ tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //dar rgyas 'phel/ bkra shis//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo bzhugs/ -PAGE 374-PAGE 375--PAGE 359
